description.zh:
取消更新资源栈类型。取值：

- Quick：尽快取消更新资源栈。

- Safe：尽可能安全地取消更新资源栈。
description.en:
The method to cancel the update operation. Valid values:

- Quick: cancels the update of a stack as soon as possible.

- Safe: cancels the update of a stack as safely as possible.

description.zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~131035~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~131035~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ros cancel-update-stack --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cancel-type Safe --region cn-hangzhou
